name: bim-bridge
description: Bootstrap Codex into the local BIM Bridge Runtime for safe Revit and AutoCAD automation.

interface.longDescription: Checks the local BIM Bridge host at the start of relevant tasks, installs or repairs it after explicit approval, and safely controls supported Revit and AutoCAD sessions through the shared runtime.
defaultPrompt: Set up BIM Bridge on this Windows PC and verify its local Autodesk connectors.
Inspect the active Revit or AutoCAD document without changing it.
Create or update Autodesk content, then verify it with structured readback.
